description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Spell Focus (Chronomancy)

Benefit: As long as you have a chronomancy spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you gain the benefit of Uncanny Dodge as a thief of your level. If you already possess Uncanny Dodge, you gain Improved Uncanny Dodge instead. Additionally, as a swift action, you may grant yourself a dodge bonus to AC equal to the highest-level chronomancy spell you can cast against the next attack made against you until the start of your next turn. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting chronomancy spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Spell Focus (Chronomancy)
